Name: Pay Day
Effect: Ranged. Projectile. At the end of the battle give Money to your Trainer Equal to their Rank: Starter/Rookie - ₽100 Standard - ₽250 Advanced - ₽500 Ace or more - ₽1000.
Description: This Pokémon brings good fortune to businesses and trainers alike. Make sure to use some of that hard earned money to buy them a treat.
